translations.idiomatic: She sold her hairpins and earrings to help her father-in-law buy a concubine, and a son was born.

sentences.zh: 逾年，舅姑相繼亡，王獨撫二幼孤，鬻手食之，並成立。

translations.literal: Within the year her parents-in-law died in succession. Wang alone raised two young orphans, earning their keep by the work of her hands, and both grew to maturity.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year her parents-in-law died in succession. Wang alone raised two young orphans, supporting them by the labor of her hands, and both grew to maturity.

sentences.zh: 李孝婦，臨武人，名中姑，適江西桂廷鳳。

translations.literal: Filial Wife Li was from Linwu, named Zhonggu, and married Gui Tingfeng of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Filial Wife Li was from Linwu. Her given name was Zhonggu, and she married Gui Tingfeng of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 姑鄧患痰疾，將不起，婦涕泣憂悼。

translations.literal: Her mother-in-law, Lady Deng, suffered from phlegm disorder and was near death. The wife wept in sorrow and dread.
translations.idiomatic: Her mother-in-law, Lady Deng, was stricken with a phlegm disorder and near death. The wife wept in sorrow and dread.

sentences.zh: 聞有言乳肉可療者，心識之。

translations.literal: Hearing that a woman's breast meat could cure the illness, she took note of it in her heart.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that a woman's breast meat could cure the illness, she kept the thought in her heart.

sentences.zh: 一日，煮藥，巘香禱竈神，自割一乳，昏仆於地，氣已絕。

translations.literal: One day, while boiling medicine, she burned incense and prayed to the stove god, then cut off one breast. She fainted to the ground, her breath already gone.
translations.idiomatic: One day, while boiling medicine, she burned incense and prayed to the stove god, then cut off one breast. She collapsed to the ground, her breath already gone.

sentences.zh: 廷鳳呼藥不至，出視，見血流滿地，大驚呼救，傾駭城市，邑長佐皆詣其廬，命亟治。

translations.literal: Tingfeng called for medicine but received no reply. He went out to look and saw blood covering the floor. Greatly alarmed, he called for help. The whole town was shaken. The magistrate and his assistants all came to their dwelling and ordered urgent treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Tingfeng called for medicine but received no reply. He went out and saw blood covering the floor. Greatly alarmed, he cried for help. The whole town was shaken. The magistrate and his assistants all came to their dwelling and ordered urgent treatment.

sentences.zh: 俄有僧踵門曰：「以室中蘄艾傅之，即愈。」

translations.literal: Soon a monk came to the door and said: "Apply the mugwort in the room to the wound, and she will recover at once."
translations.idiomatic: Soon a monk came to the door and said: "Apply the mugwort in the room to the wound, and she will recover at once."

sentences.zh: 如其言，果蘇，比求僧不復見矣。

translations.literal: They did as he said, and she indeed revived. But by the time they sought the monk again, he was nowhere to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: They did as he said, and she indeed revived. But by the time they went to find the monk again, he had vanished.

sentences.zh: 乃取乳和藥奉姑，姑竟獲全。

translations.literal: She then took the breast meat, mixed it into medicine, and presented it to her mother-in-law, who was fully restored to health.
translations.idiomatic: She then took the breast meat, mixed it into medicine, and presented it to her mother-in-law, who was fully restored to health.

sentences.zh: 又洪氏，懷寧章崇雅妻。

translations.literal: Also Lady Hong, wife of Zhang Chongya of Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Lady Hong, wife of Zhang Chongya of Huaining.

sentences.zh: 崇雅早卒，洪守志十年。

translations.literal: Chongya died early. Hong kept her vows for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Chongya died early. Hong kept her widowhood for ten years.

sentences.zh: 姑許，疾不能起，洪剜乳肉為羹而飲之，獲愈，余肉投池中，不令人知。

translations.literal: When her mother-in-law Xu fell ill and could not rise, Hong carved flesh from her breast, made it into broth, and had her drink it. Xu recovered. The remaining meat she threw into a pond, letting no one know.
translations.idiomatic: When her mother-in-law Xu fell ill and could not rise, Hong carved flesh from her breast, made it into broth, and had her drink it. Xu recovered. The remaining meat she threw into a pond, letting no one know.

sentences.zh: 數日後，群鴨自水中銜出，鳴噪回翔，小童獲以告姑。

translations.literal: Several days later, a flock of ducks brought it up from the water in their beaks, crying and wheeling about. A young servant caught one and told the mother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later, a flock of ducks brought it up from the water in their beaks, crying and wheeling about. A young servant caught one and told the mother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 姑起視之，乳血猶淋漓也。

translations.literal: Xu rose to look: the breast flesh was still dripping with blood.
translations.idiomatic: Xu rose to look: the breast flesh was still dripping with blood.

sentences.zh: 其夫兄崇古亦早亡，姒朱氏誓死靡他，妯娌相守五十年云。

translations.literal: Her husband's elder brother Chonggu had also died early. His wife, Lady Zhu, vowed never to remarry. The two sisters-in-law kept each other's company for fifty years.
translations.idiomatic: Her husband's elder brother Chonggu had also died early. His wife, Lady Zhu, vowed never to remarry. The two sisters-in-law kept each other's company for fifty years.

sentences.zh: 倪氏，興化陸鰲妻。

translations.literal: Lady Ni was the wife of Lu Ao of Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ni was the wife of Lu Ao of Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 性純孝，舅早世，憫姑老，朝夕侍寢處，與夫睽異者十五年。

translations.literal: Of pure filial nature: her father-in-law died early. Pitying her aged mother-in-law, she attended her day and night in sleeping and waking, living apart from her husband for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Utterly filial by nature, she lost her father-in-law early. Pitying her aged mother-in-law, she attended her day and night in sleeping and waking, living apart from her husband for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 姑鼻患疽垂斃，躬為吮治，不愈，乃夜焚香告天，割左臂肉以進，姑啖之愈。

translations.literal: Her mother-in-law's nose was afflicted with a gangrenous sore near death. Ni personally sucked and treated it, but it did not heal. She then burned incense at night and prayed to Heaven, cut flesh from her left arm to present, and when her mother-in-law ate it, she recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Her mother-in-law's nose was afflicted with a gangrenous sore near death. Ni personally sucked and treated the wound, but it did not heal. She then burned incense at night and prayed to Heaven, cut flesh from her left arm to present, and when her mother-in-law ate it, she recovered.

sentences.zh: 遠近稱孝婦。

translations.literal: Near and far they praised her as a filial wife.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far they praised her as a filial wife.

sentences.zh: 劉氏，張能信妻，太僕卿憲寵女，工部尚書九德婦也。

translations.literal: Lady Liu was the wife of Zhang Nengxin, daughter of Grand Master for the Imperial Studs Zhang Xianchong, and daughter-in-law of Minister of Works Zhang Jiude.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Liu was the wife of Zhang Nengxin, daughter of Grand Master for the Imperial Studs Zhang Xianchong and daughter-in-law of Minister of Works Zhang Jiude.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，姑病十年，侍湯藥不離側。

translations.literal: Utterly filial by nature: her mother-in-law was ill for ten years, and Liu attended her with medicines never leaving her side.
translations.idiomatic: Utterly filial by nature, she nursed her mother-in-law through ten years of illness, never leaving her side with medicines and care.

sentences.zh: 及病劇，舉刀刲臂，侍婢驚持之。

translations.literal: When the illness grew critical, she raised a knife to cut her arm. A maid in attendance, startled, seized her.
translations.idiomatic: When the illness grew critical, she raised a knife to cut her arm. A maid in attendance, startled, seized her.

sentences.zh: 舅聞，囑醫言病不宜近腥膩，力止之。

translations.literal: Her father-in-law heard and instructed the physician to say the illness ought not be exposed to rich or greasy foods, forcibly stopping her.
translations.idiomatic: Her father-in-law heard and instructed the physician to say the illness ought not be exposed to rich or greasy foods, forcibly stopping her.

sentences.zh: 逾日，竟刲肉煮糜以進，則乃姑已不能食，乃大悔恨曰：「醫紿我，使姑未鑒我心。」

translations.literal: The next day she cut flesh after all and boiled it into congee to present—but by then her mother-in-law could no longer eat. She repented bitterly: "The physician deceived me, so that my mother-in-law never witnessed my heart."
translations.idiomatic: The next day she cut flesh after all and boiled it into congee to present—but by then her mother-in-law could no longer eat. She repented bitterly: "The physician deceived me, so that my mother-in-law never witnessed my devotion."

sentences.zh: 復刲肉寸許，慟哭奠簀前，將闔棺，取所奠置棺中曰：「婦不獲復事我姑，以此肉伴姑側，猶身事姑也。」

translations.literal: Again she cut off an inch of flesh, wept bitterly, and placed it as an offering before the mat on which her mother-in-law lay. When the coffin was about to be closed, she took what she had offered and placed it in the coffin, saying: "Your daughter-in-law can no longer serve you in person. Let this flesh keep company at your side—it is as though I still attend you."
translations.idiomatic: Again she cut off an inch of flesh, wept bitterly, and placed it as an offering before the mat on which her mother-in-law lay. When the coffin was about to be closed, she took what she had offered and placed it in the coffin, saying: "Your daughter-in-law can no longer serve you in person. Let this flesh keep you company—it is as though I still attend you."

sentences.zh: 鄉人莫不稱其孝。

translations.literal: The people of the district all praised her filial devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the district all praised her filial devotion.
